title: Graveyard Shift
summary: Confidential payroll template with an interactive browser explanation of public, employee, auditor and coworker views. November 5 review: the page still replays creator-generated engine results; switching views and the recorded payslip examples worked without a wallet. It does not decrypt or submit payroll in the browser. Repository revision a46223f is unchanged with no published releases. The October 22 creator reply documents an historical Esmeralda payroll, but that component now returns not found after the November 2 reset. The roster, role labels, payment status and total budget remain public; the fixed auditor key reveals amounts but cannot spend or read employee memos. Retained October footage is a concept overview of this replay, not a new payroll run. MIT source, testnet only.
cardSummary: Explore recorded payroll results from employee, auditor and public perspectives, with selective disclosure of individual payslips.
